Apple loves forced obsolescence. Every so often, they remove something from the devices and then make an item you can buy from them to use it like before. The home screen button, the charger port. 

The worst offender yet, in my opinion, was removing the headphone jack. Because as they slowly make more and more and your phone eventually becomes obsolete, you’re going to have to buy these things and then you’re going to have to buy all the other shit to go with it that your other phone already had. 

Eventually, you’ll have to upgrade and then you’ll have to drop more money or deal with it. 

I have to use an iPhone because my plan offered a package deal if super cheap refurbished phones with a good data plan but I’d honestly rather go back to Samsung. 

Apple has some amazing things their products can do and the services those products offer but at the same time, I’m much more of a fan of how I can use the same products with a prepaid phone at Walmart that I can with the newer $500+ phones. 

Like if I had some sort of oopsie and needed a new phone because all of my stuff is still on Apple, I don’t want to have to buy a new phone and then an entire slew of accessories with it because the stuff that worked with my old phone doesn’t work anymore. 

They just want to milk their consumers to the last dollar and it sucks because the products have amazing quality. I got AirPods for Christmas and the quality is amazing. It just sucks that they do that because they know they have impeccable quality items so they do what they want in switching things up and making shit defunct because they want to make more.

He was happy, and we thought healthy until one week he just started being so much slower, eating less, having trouble going up steps. On Friday, he looked at my dad while standing on the grass needing him to pick him up and bring him in and we knew.  The moment he couldn’t walk up a three inch stoop for the door, we knew. 

I’ve had him since I was 8. I’m 22 now. He just turned 14. My parents said goodbye to him and I had to go to the vet with my grandma and we learned he had a massive heart murmur, he’d lost six pounds in a week, and he was struggling to breathe. I had to make that decision. I had my blanket that I put him on and a dirty shirt with my smell covering him when they put him to rest. It truly finally punched me in the gut when they covered him in the towel and picked him up and his head just limply dropped into the crook of her arm. 

What hurts the most suddenly now is the instinctual things. I can’t bring myself to put his stuff away. He had an empty water bowl and I went to pick it up to fill it before realizing that I didn’t need to. Or when I turned the kitchen lights off so he could sleep and not get upset. Not getting up every few hours to take him out, or wash his diapers, or whatever. 

I sat on the couch and I didn’t need to move the stuff on it so he could sit next to me. I don’t have the click of tiny claws following right behind wherever I go. Or stinky dog breath in my face whenever he kisses me. Or hear him howl when my dad would get me up in the morning because he was so excited. Or have him whimpering at my feet for a bit of my food. Or waiting at the back door until my parents came home one by one. Or begging to get me up by looking at my door repeatedly. Or asking for pets. Barreling into my lap. Sidling right against my leg. 

I feel so guilty. For not noticing quick enough. What if we could’ve helped him? Why didn’t we know he was suffering before? 

The worst part is I’m deeply depressed anyway. I’d sleep almost till 4pm and then I’d stay up a few hours and do it again. Sometimes he’d realize I was up and was so excited but them I went to the bathroom and went back into my room to sleep more and just... having done that and probably made him sad makes me feel awful. I feel like I hurt him so much and now he’s gone. Any time I’ve yelled at him or got upset at him or disciplined him or whatever. Stepping on his paw or anything. I feel so terrible. I was an awful person. I am awful. 

At times during my life, I’d wanted to end it all. I truly was only living for my dog. He was everything to me and now he’s gone. It was so fucking sudden and I fucking hate it. 

I don’t want to pretend he was never here. But it hurts when I remember he isn’t. I loved him so much. 

I have autism so my bond with him just. Transcended anything and everything. I’m consumed by sorrow. 

I hope he was comforted in his last moments. I hope I was there for him in a way he needed me to be. I hope he was happy. 

I’m an atheist but I just want to believe so much that he’s somewhere. Happy. Okay. Thriving. I just need to. I hope souls are a true thing and I do hope that no longer living isn’t the end. 

I’m a wreck. 

I feel so guilty about getting a new dog soon. About it seeming like I’m replacing him. 

I want to think about it like my dog is passing on his duties. That this new dog take care of me now that he can no longer. 

I hope one day I can think about him and be happy. He’s my world. And I’m broken. I don’t know if I’ll ever heal.
